meta.name: standup
meta.description: Facilitate a read-only standup across git worktrees, branches, or PRs to compare changes and produce one consolidation plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 汇总多个分支或PR的变更，生成统一计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在多个工作分支间快速同步变更并制定合并计划
copy.tagline_en: Aggregate changes across branches or PRs into one consolidation plan
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly sync changes across multiple work branches and create a merge plan

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会担任主持人,把你的每个 git 工作树、分支或 PR 当成一个 agent,拉进一个共享 Markdown 房间分轮对话,最后产出一份合并计划。
howto.when: 当你想比较多个工作树、分支或 PR 的改动,并要一份统一的合并方案时触发。若候选只有 0 或 1 个,它会说明这不算 standup 并停下。

say.text: 看看最近 4 小时有改动的工作树,开个 standup
say.note: 它会列出候选并让你确认名单。

say.text: 把这几个分支和打开的 PR 放一起比对,给我合并顺序
say.note: 房间里逐轮协商,最后交你拍板。

say.text: 计划定了就交给 /do 去执行合并
say.note: 它自己不会在 /do 之外做合并。

howto.what_en: Claude acts as facilitator: each of your git worktrees, branches, or PRs joins a shared Markdown room as its own agent, talks in rounds, and produces one consolidation plan.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to compare changes across several worktrees, branches, or PRs and get one consolidation plan. With zero or one candidate it says this isn't a standup and stops.

say_en.text: Look at worktrees active in the last 4 hours and start a standup
say_en.note: It lists candidates and confirms the roster.

say_en.text: Compare these branches and open PRs, then give me a merge order
say_en.note: Agents negotiate in rounds; you decide the calls.

say_en.text: Once the plan is settled, hand it to /do to run the merges
